dialogues.speaker: Vedenev
dialogues.text: News, news, get your latest news here! Get the latest, if not the greatest, news here!

dialogues.speaker: Vedenev
dialogues.text: The greatest news? That'd be the one about how someone caught this Kresnik Kristall bug that grew out of someone else's back over at Gornylo! With a rope, no less!

dialogues.speaker: Vedenev
dialogues.text: And then they took the bug for a walk around Gornylo! To show everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Vedenev
dialogues.text: It's about um... Something something that was passed by the Ve—Vecha...? Probably something about mechas...

dialogues.speaker: Vedenev
dialogues.text: And um... and... Something about the Transport Burrow's logo... they must have shipped tons of rabbits here from somewhere again...

dialogues.speaker: Vedenev
dialogues.text: Alright... To be honest, I have no idea why people find the newspaper so interesting...
